name: Cold Show: Critter Comforts
source:
It's never snowed in the Golden City before, and now there's suddenly a snowstorm of terrifying size. For Blackstone Bunny, this may be something he's seen before, but he's ill-equipped for the things that came in with the snow.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/cold-show-critter-comforts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
黄金城从来没有下过雪，现在突然下起了一场规模恐怖的暴风雪。对于黑石兔子来说，这可能是他以前见过的东西，但他对随着雪而来的东西却没有足够的准备。

[来自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/cold-show-critter-comforts]Itch.io[/url]]
